solves.reasoning: (A): Focal(초점)이 원문 (Central=중심=다른 단어). (B): coordinate(조율하다)가 맞음 (compete=경쟁=반대). (C): lively(활기찬)가 맞음 (deserted=황량한=반대). → Focal/coordinate/lively = ②
(A): equilibrium(균형)이 원문. (B): safe(안전한)가 원문 (vulnerable=취약한=반대). (C): indication(징후/표시)이 원문 (contradiction=모순=반대). → equilibrium/safe/indication = ①
(A): arranges(마련한다)가 원문. (B): whimsically(변덕스럽게)가 원문. (C): rational(합리적인)이 원문. → arranges/whimsically/rational = ③
①spread(맞음), ②dangerous('safe from muggers'가 원문, dangerous=위험=반대로 부적절), ③equilibrium(맞음), ④coordinate(맞음) → ②
①difference(맞음), ②predictably('whimsically'가 원문, predictably=예측가능하게=반대로 부적절), ③whimsical(맞음), ④rational(맞음) → ②
①ritualistic(맞음), ②abandon('retain'이 원문→하지만 이번 문항은 다른 마커 구성), ③rational('whimsical'이 원문, rational=합리적=반대로 부적절), ④sustainable(맞음) → ③
'create a focal point around which others _____' → 조율하다 → coordinate = ②
'Saturday mornings can still be _____ at the playground' → 활기찬 → lively = ④
'whimsically _____ these multiple equilibria can be' → 예측 불가능한 → unpredictable = ①
muggers=강도. 1.robbers(강도=동의어) 2.neighbors(이웃) 3.performers(공연자) 4.regulars(단골) → robbers = ①
indication=표시/징후. 1.obstacle(장애물) 2.prediction(예측) 3.sign(표시=동의어) 4.outcome(결과) → sign = ③
arranges=마련하다/준비하다. 1.cancels(취소) 2.abandons(포기) 3.prevents(방해) 4.organizes(조직하다=동의어) → organizes = ④
rational=합리적인. 반의어: 1.logical(논리적) 2.calculated(계산된) 3.absurd(터무니없는=반의어) 4.systematic(체계적) → absurd = ③
whimsically=변덕스럽게. 반의어: 1.capriciously(변덕스럽게=유사어) 2.erratically(불규칙하게) 3.randomly(무작위로) 4.deliberately(의도적으로=반의어) → deliberately = ④
(A) 'soccer team comes to practice' → practice=연습(동사). (B) 'practice of gathering' → practice=관행/관습(명사). → (A)연습-(B)관행 = ①
'a state of balance between opposing forces' = equilibrium(균형). 1.indication 2.coordination 3.equilibrium 4.focal point → equilibrium = ③
'how __________(whimsy) unpredictable' → unpredictable를 수식하는 부사 → whimsically
'arranges a __________(regularity) trip' → trip을 수식하는 형용사 → regular
'With the team at practice...so families will _____' → 공원을 이용하러 올 것이다 → 'come along to use the park' = ①
'yet while the outcome is _____' → 결과는 변덕스럽다 → 'whimsical' = ④
